tasks.completion_summary: Split ScanAndCleanup into scan phase (under lock) and kill phase (outside lock) to reduce mutex hold time from 0.1-5s to just the scan duration

Buffered all Renderer Draw/Clear methods to build ANSI output in bytes.Buffer under lock, then write to terminal after unlock. Three overlay-stack methods (ClearMenu, ResetMenuRegions, ClearCurrentMenu) kept with defer unlock since they write through ScreenManager's own writer.
Replaced tailscaleDNSMu RWMutex with atomic.Pointer[string] + atomic.Int64 timestamp + atomic.Bool busy flag. getTailscaleDNS() is now fully lock-free with async background refresh.

Replaced I/O-under-lock with write-behind channels in both StateManager and SchedulerStateManager. Background goroutines drain write signals with debounce coalescing. Mutex only protects in-memory state. Added Close() for flush-on-shutdown to both managers and wired into daemon Stop().
Moved Scheduler.Start LoadAllTasks() before lock acquisition. Added atomic restartCount/lastRestartTime to processRestartState so Stats() reads atomics instead of acquiring per-process mutex locks.

Added RunAutostartAsync(ctx, projectPath, progress) with AutostartProgress events. RunAutostart delegates with nil progress (backward compat). Replaced layerWg.Wait() with select on layerDone+ctx.Done(). Added WaitReadyCtx to ReadySignaler. Preserved 120s fallback timeout when caller uses context.Background() for backward compat. Progress events emitted at PhaseScriptStarting/DependencyWaitStart/DependencyReady/ScriptStarted/ScriptFailed/LayerComplete.

Added AutostartManager + AutostartHandle in autostart_manager.go with sync.Map-based exactly-once GetOrCreate, RWMutex-protected progress history, Cancel/Progress/Get/Remove APIs, and synthetic PhaseDone event on completion. Moved AutostartPhase/AutostartProgress/phase constants from daemon_autostart.go to the new file (single source of truth), added ProjectPath+Timestamp fields stamped by emitProgress and by the manager drain goroutine. Updated all 6 emitProgress callsites in daemon_autostart.go to pass projectPath. Added PhaseDone constant for overall completion. 8 new tests cover exactly-once, cancel running/completed, progress accumulation, different paths, late-joiner snapshot, path normalization, and Progress query. Full daemon suite passes with race detector in 217s.

Decoupled hubHandleSessionRegister from autostart by wiring the new AutostartManager into Daemon. Registration now calls GetOrCreate with a project-scoped startFn that runs the duplicate scan inside the background autostart run (no more projectMu lock) and tees progress events onto the alert hub as diagnostic log entries. Response schema gained status/autostart_handle/progress/result fields while keeping the legacy autostart map for backward compatibility (populated synchronously when the run finishes before WriteJSON returns). Removed projectLocks sync.Map and getProjectLock from daemon.go; the old per-project mutex tests were replaced with a GetOrCreate-based sharing test. Autostart handles are now removed from the manager in CleanupSessionResources when the last session for a project disconnects (matches the ephemeral registry rule). Added 5 new tests in hub_session_async_test.go covering sub-500ms registration with slow autostart, status=starting/joined/done branches, late-joiner progress snapshot, and no-global-serialization across distinct projects. Also fixed a pre-existing failing E2E assertion (TestE2E_AutostartIdempotent_RestartsAfterAllDisconnect) that contradicted the ephemeral-registry architectural rule. Full daemon suite passes with -race in 217s; all E2E autostart tests pass; gofmt and go vet clean.

Wired autostart cancellation into the last-session cleanup path. doCleanup now calls autostartManager.Cancel(projectPath) BEFORE Remove(projectPath) — order matters because Cancel looks the handle up by key and is a no-op once Remove deletes the entry. This propagates ctx.Done() to the RunAutostartAsync goroutine so an in-flight autostart actually stops when the project's last session disconnects (previously Remove orphaned the goroutine). The 5s deferred-cleanup grace period in CleanupSessionResourcesDeferred is unchanged, so reconnecting clients still withdraw the cancellation. Added daemon_session_cleanup_test.go with 5 race-clean tests: cancel-on-last-session, no-cancel-when-other-sessions-remain, cancel-after-both-disconnect, reconnect-within-grace-withdraws-cancel, and no-panic-when-no-handle. Full daemon suite passes with -race in 217s; gofmt and go vet clean.

Removed the 120s implicit dependency-wait fallback. Root cause was two-fold: (1) waitForSingleDependency wrapped every wait in DefaultDependencyTimeout when the parent ctx had no deadline (production session ctx never has a deadline), and (2) the .agnt.kdl parser defaulted every dep.Timeout to 120s, so even removing the daemon-side fallback would not have produced indefinite waits. Fix: parser now defaults dep.Timeout to 0 (wait indefinitely); waitForSingleDependency wraps the wait in context.WithTimeout only when dep.Timeout > 0 (explicit user-set timeout in KDL still honored). Removed parentHasDeadline branch and parameter. DefaultDependencyTimeout constant retained for backward compat with internal/autostart (dead/parallel impl) and existing topo-sort fixture tests. Added two tests: NoFallbackTimeout_WaitsIndefinitely (proves the wait blocks past 6s and unblocks promptly on parent ctx cancel), ExplicitDependencyTimeout_StillHonored (proves timeout=2 in KDL still bounds the wait, and never falls into 120s fallback). Updated 3 assertions in agnt_deps_test.go from DefaultDependencyTimeout to 0. Build, vet, gofmt clean; targeted daemon+config tests pass with -race.

Refactored daemon_autostart.go (startAutostartScripts 130->33 lines via runLayer+startOneScript+setupReadinessSignal extraction) and hub_session.go (hubHandleSessionRegister 168->41 lines via parseSessionRegisterArgs+joinOrStartAutostart+buildSessionRegisterResponse+logSessionTargetStarting+claimProjectScripts extraction); deleted dead code _old_detectPortForScript and detectPortForScript stub plus the test that validated them. AutostartProgress field audit found no unused fields (all 7 fields are read).

Audited daemon tests for synchronous-autostart assumptions after iter 6/7/8/11 async refactor. Most call sites already use handle.Done() correctly (daemon_session_cleanup_test.go, hub_session_async_test.go, autostart_manager_test.go, TestDaemon_AutostartManager_SharedPerProject). Only wall-clock sleep that actually masked a race was TestSessionBasedCleanup's post-Close() 500ms sleep; replaced with a 5s polling loop on ProcList that breaks as soon as the expected process count (1) is reached, cutting the test from ~560ms to ~40ms and removing wall-clock dependence. session_test.go is pure SessionRegistry unit tests with no autostart or hub-handler coupling, so no changes there. Full daemon test suite passes in ~110s; individual tests all <10s (well under the 30s acceptance target). go vet and gofmt clean.

rAF-batched mousemove bounding-rect reads in three devtool scripts. design.js:106 and style-editor.js:270 (element-select hover) now cache last pointer coords into pendingMove and defer elementFromPoint + getBoundingClientRect into processPendingMove scheduled via requestAnimationFrame; rafId cancelled by __devtoolCancelRaf hook wired into hideSelectionOverlay/removeOverlay. indicator.js has two fixes: (1) startElementMode overlay.onmousemove (was at 3589) uses the same pendingMove/processPendingMove/rafId pattern, with cleanup() cancelling the pending frame; (2) handleDragStart's onMove now stores pendingDelta and schedules applyPendingDrag via rAF, which applies style writes AND calls updatePanelPosition+positionSparkline in one frame (coalescing layout thrash from the per-frame getBoundingClientRect reads on state.bug). onUp flushes any pending delta before savePrefs so the final position is always applied. Textarea auto-expand thrash fix: replaced the style.height='auto'+scrollHeight read pattern with an off-screen measurement div (mirrors font/padding/border/width once at creation, visibility:hidden, left:-9999px, white-space:pre-wrap); scheduleTextareaResize defers the measurement offsetHeight read + textarea.style.height write into a single rAF callback, and the panel.offsetHeight reposition-upward logic is deferred to a nested rAF so it runs after the textarea height change settles. composedPath() conversions: indicator.js:2711 (mega-menu outside click) and style-editor.js:701 (panel outside click) both fall back to Node.contains() when composedPath is unavailable. indicator.js:3594 (state.container.contains(el) on hover filter) left alone because el comes from elementFromPoint not from an event. go test ./... passes; go vet and gofmt clean; node -c syntax check clean on all three JS files.

Added CSS contain + will-change to devtool UI containers for scoped layout/paint invalidation. REJECTED the obvious approach of putting contain on #__devtool-indicator root because the wrapper div holds fixed-positioned children (bug, panel, outputPreview, sparkline, microToast) whose containing block would be reparented to the 0x0 wrapper and destroy viewport-relative positioning. Instead applied contain: layout style to each top-level fixed child individually (STYLES.bug, panel, outputPreview, microToast, tabContent) and contain: content to sparkline (52x12 fixed with overflow:hidden). paint is intentionally omitted everywhere box-shadows or activity rings extend outside the element's box: bug (glow + ring at top:-4px), panel (megaMenu dropdown opens upward via position:absolute bottom:calc(100% + 4px)), outputPreview (box-shadow lg), microToast (backdrop box-shadow), tabContent (megaMenu inside Compose tab). overlay.js #__devtool-overlays got contain: layout style (viewport-sized fixed, absolute children). toast.js STYLES.container and STYLES.toast both got contain: layout style; toast items also got will-change: transform, opacity because they're short-lived (4s default, maxVisible:3) so GPU memory bounded. will-change was scoped via CSS class toggles (.__devtool-entrance, .__devtool-active, .__devtool-bug-active) which are added/removed in setActivityState and animationend, not always-on. Breathing animation (__devtool-breathe) intentionally skipped because it animates box-shadow only (paint property, no GPU compositing benefit). Panel transition wrapped with JS-toggled style.willChange set on togglePanel(true/false) and cleared via 300ms timeout after the 0.2s transition settles. go test ./... passes (all packages); go vet and gofmt clean; node -c syntax check clean on all three JS files.

Migrated devtool indicator + overlay UI to a single Shadow DOM root for style isolation from host pages. New internal/proxy/scripts/shadow-root.js creates <div id=__devtool-root> on document.documentElement (not document.body, to avoid transform/filter containing-block issues) and attaches an OPEN shadow root (intentional deviation from task spec's 'closed' suggestion: open preserves Chrome DevTools inspection of devtool UI itself, and style isolation is identical in both modes). Exposes window.__devtoolGetMountRoot() and window.__devtoolIsShadowMount() plus idempotent self-guard. Falls back to document.body if attachShadow throws (legacy/CSP). embed.go: new shadow-root module registered FIRST after core (no deps), and added as an explicit dep to overlay and indicator. overlay.js:40 mount switched from document.documentElement to mountRoot(). indicator.js: added mountRoot/isShadowMount/getInMount/styleTarget helpers at top of IIFE; migrated 11 sites: main container mount (line 1650), 2 global <style> injections (__devtool-activity-style + __devtool-container-style now go through styleTarget() which resolves to the shadow root when active), 9 document.getElementById calls for internal elements (__devtool-activity-ring, __devtool-tab-* x6, __devtool-tab-content, __devtool-message, __devtool-status) now use getInMount() which uses ShadowRoot.getElementById (from DocumentFragment) when shadow is active. Also migrated 4 document.body.appendChild sites: textarea measurement el, element preview highlight, attachment preview popup, screenshot selection overlay, element selection overlay. getInMount() branches on isShadowMount() because document.body does not have getElementById but ShadowRoot does. Outside-click already uses composedPath() from iter 13 so crossing the shadow boundary works. Element-mode overlay's document.elementFromPoint + overlay.style.pointerEvents='none' trick still works because open shadow roots are hit-testable from document level. Added embed_test.go TestShadowRootBootstrapOrder verifying shadow-root appears in deps of overlay+indicator, shadow-root.js exposes __devtoolGetMountRoot and __devtoolIsShadowMount, uses mode: 'open' not 'closed', and is emitted before overlay and indicator in the combined script. Full go test ./... passes in 114s for daemon + all others; go vet and gofmt clean; node -c clean on all 3 JS files.

Migrated audit mega menu from JS-positioned position:fixed (interim iter 16 fix) to native HTML Popover API for top-layer rendering. Feature-detects 'popover' in HTMLElement.prototype; pre-baseline browsers fall through to the legacy JS-positioned path which is preserved inside the if(!supportsPopover) branch. Modern path: menu.popover='auto' + btn.setAttribute('popovertarget', menu.id) + mountRoot().appendChild(menu) so both btn and menu sit inside the same shadow root (popovertarget does NOT cross shadow boundaries, so mounting to mountRoot() is required when iter 15's shadow DOM is active). beforetoggle listener handles responsive grid columns, rAF-deferred reposition (offsetWidth/Height are 0 during beforetoggle so rAF is mandatory), active-button styling on open, coordinate clear + listener cleanup on close. Scroll listener hides the popover via menu.hidePopover() wrapped in try/catch + :popover-open check to survive light-dismiss races. Resize listener reuses the shared scheduleReposition. Added injectAuditMenuStyles() that injects CSS rules via styleTarget() (shadow-root when active) for [popover]#__devtool-audit-menu{opacity/transform/transition overlay 0.15s allow-discrete, display 0.15s allow-discrete} + :popover-open{opacity:1; transform:translateY(0)} + @starting-style for the initial fade-in. STYLES.megaMenu updated with margin:0 + inset:unset to override browser defaults for [popover] elements. buildMenuItem onclick routes through new dismissMenu() helper which calls menu.hidePopover() on the modern path and legacyClose() (assigned from the legacy branch's closeDropdown) on the legacy path; hoisted legacyClose var avoids strict-mode block-scoped function declaration issues. Adversarial review: (1) popovertarget works inside shadow root because both elements are in the same tree; (2) beforetoggle 'closed' fires for ALL close paths (click, Escape, light-dismiss, programmatic hidePopover) so cleanup runs identically; (3) open->close->open races are handled via stable closure-scoped listener refs + rafPositionId cancellation; (4) legacy path is byte-for-byte preserved (only the wrapping if-block is new, plus the delegation to legacyClose for menu-item dismissal); (5) CSS selector [popover]#__devtool-audit-menu works inside shadow root because style is injected into styleTarget() which returns the shadow root when active; (6) hidePopover() race with light-dismiss handled via try/catch + matches(':popover-open') check. node -c indicator.js clean; go vet ./... clean; gofmt clean; go test ./... pass.

Daemon-side HealthTracker observes process state edges lazily and gates the proxy → AlertHub broadcast path during rebuild/outage windows. New internal/daemon/health_tracker.go: HealthTracker with sync.Map of processHealthState (per-process atomic.Uint32 lastObservedState + atomic.Pointer[time.Time] lastHealthyAt + atomic.Bool suppressionOpen), IsInSuppressionWindow(proxyID, linkedProcessID) hot path = sync.Map.Load + atomic loads (no global locks), slow path takes per-process mutex only on state-edge detection. Suppression matrix: Pending→pass, Starting/Stopping/Failed→suppress, Running within 5s grace→suppress, Running past grace→pass, Stopped (Dead) →pass. Grace is the SuppressionGracePeriod constant = 5s. Lazy edge detection: tracker observes state on every check, compares to stored lastObservedState; on edge it stamps lastHealthyAt (transition INTO Running) and emits diagnostic open/close markers via closure-injected emitter that bypasses the gate by being LogTypeDiagnostic. MaybeCloseGraceWindow is called by the gate just before passing an entry through, so the close marker fires at the same instant errors actually start flowing again (idempotent — only emits once per edge). Reverse index: added d.proxyToScript map[proxyID]scriptID populated alongside d.scriptProxies in trackScriptProxy and cleared in clearScriptProxies. linkedScriptForProxy() lookup uses scriptProxyMu RLock. Wiring: hub_helpers.go wireProxyLogger now routes through d.proxyBroadcastGate(proxyID, entry) which short-circuits LogTypeDiagnostic to true, otherwise calls IsInSuppressionWindow + MaybeCloseGraceWindow. Diagnostic markers are NEVER suppressed (gate bypass) so the agent always sees the open/close transitions. Ring buffer is unaffected: TrafficLogger.log() writes tl.entries[idx] = entry BEFORE invoking the onLogEntry callback, so proxylog query continues to surface suppressed entries. NEW file health_tracker_test.go with 15 tests: SuppressionWindow_StartingStopping, _HealthyWithGrace (transition + 2.5s + 5.5s), _HealthyPastGrace, _Unlinked, _Dead, _MissingProcess (ghost process), _RestartCycle (Healthy→Stopping→Healthy→Stopping within 6s — fresh grace window per edge), DiagnosticMarkers_FireOnceOnTransition (5x checks per state, exactly one open + one close marker), _DirectStoppedSkipsGrace (Failed→Stopped emits close immediately), Forget_DropsState, NilTracker_NeverSuppresses (defensive), BroadcastGate_Suppressed/_PassesThroughWhenHealthy/_DiagnosticAlwaysPasses/_UnlinkedProxyAlwaysPasses. fakeClock advances time deterministically via atomic.Pointer[time.Time]. Adversarial answers: (1) double-restart within 6s — fresh lastHealthyAt stamp per Running edge, second Stopping suppresses correctly; (2) atomic.Pointer[time.Time].Load() returns nil on never-stored, code handles via fall-back to no-suppression; (3) ring buffer write happens before broadcast gate per logger.go:582; (4) diagnostic markers bypass gate by Type check — verified by TestBroadcastGate_DiagnosticAlwaysPasses; (5) missing process returns false — verified by TestSuppressionWindow_MissingProcess; (6) handleExplicitStart path does NOT call trackScriptProxy so unlinked autostart proxies have proxyToScript[id]=='' and the gate falls through; (7) lock-free hot path: sync.Map.Load + 2 atomic.Uint32 loads in steady state, only mutex is per-process on edge transitions and an RLock in linkedScriptForProxy (reader-shared, low contention); (8) emit defer-recover absorbs any panic in diagnostic emitter. No vendored package changes — daemon-side tracker (option b) per task spec. Files touched: 5 within budget. go test ./... pass in 124s daemon + others; go vet clean; gofmt clean; binary builds at 60485093 bytes.
